create_autorejectdrop: create an AutoRejectDrop instance with drop and inplace flags for EEG epoch processing
run_transform: run the transform method on fitted AutoRejectDrop to interpolate bad sensors and optionally drop epochs
run_fit_transform: run fit_transform on AutoRejectDrop to fit thresholds and clean EEG epochs in one step
ensure_valid_positions: ensure EEG channel positions are valid by renaming bipolar M1/M2 referenced channels to monopolar
review_autorejectdrop_class: review the AutoRejectDrop class that extends AutoReject with inplace processing and epoch dropping support
